subject: general
question: Seven people Q, R, Y, W, T, E, and U are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of R. U sits at the extreme right. Only two people sit between Q and R. T is the immediate neighbour of R and Y. W is the immediate neighbour of Q and E. Who sits at the centre of the row?
solution:
Seven people **Q, R, Y, W, T, E, and U** are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1. U sits at the extreme right.

2. Only three people sit to the left of R. 

3. Only two people sit between Q and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8a0325c17e5135b4a487992f2d354bd75d9820ad6211372ae2657a5eceb5463.png] 

4. W is the immediate neighbour of Q and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17772195aed5810e067c25fdc30c8d160ffe5ed1fefafb52d9261fa707dba860.png] 

4. T is the immediate neighbour of R and Y. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1431cfd28a929cb445a32dd005c68c55104d42166a7872e52147533ac167ba6.png] 

Clearly, R sits at the centre of the row.

Hence, '**R**' is the correct answer.
